thread:
marta: Partner ACME-SI + Nebula (HW) just asked for a full compliance bundle to push the joint offer to Azure Marketplace by next Tue. Items listed: SOC2 Type II report, pen-test executive summary, completed vendor questionnaire, sanitized network diagram, and an artifacts index. Who can own each piece?
logan: I can do the sanitized diagram + architecture redaction. Need a list of what to redact (IPs, customer names, internal employee IDs). Any required template?
carla: I'll pull the pen-test exec summary from Cobalt and extract the high-level findings. We only share exec summary + evidence index (no raw logs). Will need legal ok on wording.
samir: I can handle the SOC2 PDF upload to the marketplace bundle. Question: do we upload the full report or a SOC2 attestation letter? Marketplace usually wants full report for listing review.
marta: Marketplace policy: full SOC2 Type II (redacted PII) + pen-test executive summary. We must also submit the completed vendor questionnaire (they gave their standard cloud marketplace questionnaire). Legal wants a final review before submission.
joe_si: ACME-SI side: I'll coordinate with Nebula and attach the HW-specific security statement. I can host an S3 presigned bundle for you to fetch.
marketplace-bot: :package: New JIRA MPART-4521 created for "ACME-SI + Nebula marketplace compliance bundle" assigned to partnerships. Due date set to 5 days from now.
marta: Ownership proposal: SOC2 upload -> samir; pen-test exec summary -> carla; vendor questionnaire -> marta (legal loop); sanitized diagram -> logan; artifact index + presigned link -> joe_si. Can everyone ack?
logan: ack. I'll follow the redaction checklist: remove internal hostnames, mask IPs to /24, strip MACs, remove screenshots with customer data. Will upload diagram to s3://marketplace-evidence/MPART-4521/diagrams/ (ask for presign).
carla: ack. Will redact any vulnerability PoCs and attach only mitigations and timelines. Expect a draft by EOD tomorrow.
samir: ack. Need KMS key name for encryption and what TTL for presigned link. Marketplace prefers 72h. Also, who will do the final naming convention for bundle files?
marta: KMS key: mp-marketplace-evidence. Presign TTL: 72h default. File naming: <marketplace-id>_<artifact_type>_<YYYYMMDD>. Example: mp-8891_SOC2_20240315.pdf. Listing id is mp-8891.
joe_si: Presigned link (temporary): https://s3-presign.example/MPART-4521-bundle (we'll upload once we have the redacted files). TTL will be 72h. I'll rotate link for each upload iteration.
carla: Quick Q — marketplace reviewers sometimes ask for the pen-test scope. Do we include a one-paragraph scope description or the full scope appendix?
marta: Include a one-paragraph scope in the exec summary plus a scope table in the artifact index. No raw scan outputs.
logan: I'll produce the sanitized diagram and drop it in the presign path once I get markup comments from infra. Need infra to confirm we can mask certain diagram blocks. @samir can you loop infra?
samir: looping infra now. Tagging infra-oncall. Also creating MPART-4521 subtask for the upload steps with exact S3 paths and KMS policy.
marketplace-bot: :calendar: Reminder set: "MPART-4521 compliance sync" Thu 10:00 with stakeholders.
marta: Timeline recap: drafts due EOD tomorrow (diagram, pen summary), SOC2 redaction ready in 48h, final bundle assembled and presigned by Mon EOD, legal final review Mon night, submit Tue morning. If anyone needs to push, flag now.
joe_si: ACME-SI will provide the vendor questionnaire answers by tomorrow noon. Also sending a short HW security attestation PDF.
carla: noted. I'll keep the pen-test redaction conservative to avoid rework.
logan: one more ask — network diagram needs a short caption explaining what was redacted and why. I'll add that caption file.
marta: perfect. I'll own the questionnaire + legal sign-off. Thanks everyone — I'll post final upload checklist to MPART-4521 and ping when presigned link is live. :thumbsup:
joe_si: thanks all — ACME-SI on standby for any clarifications.
marketplace-bot: :white_check_mark: Thread archived into partnerships channel log."
